name: AGNTCY Agent Identity
description: Linux Foundation-hosted identity service for agents, MCP servers and multi-agent systems.
descriptionZh: Linux Foundation 托管、面向 Agent / MCP Server / 多 Agent 系统的身份服务。
keyFact: AGNTCY Agent Identity is an Apache-2.0 service that verifies, registers and issues identities (badges) for MCP servers, A2A agents and OASF entities; AGNTCY was open-sourced by Cisco in March 2025 and donated to the Linux Foundation on 29 July 2025.
keyFactZh: AGNTCY Agent Identity 是 Apache-2.0 许可的服务，为 MCP Server、A2A Agent 与 OASF 实体验证、注册并签发身份（badge）；AGNTCY 由 Cisco 于 2025 年 3 月开源，并于 2025 年 7 月 29 日捐赠给 Linux Foundation。
caveat: Adoption is light despite heavyweight governance: roughly 2,000 GitHub stars across the whole AGNTCY org as of June 2026.
caveatZh: 治理阵容虽强但采用度偏低：截至 2026 年 6 月，整个 AGNTCY 组织在 GitHub 上合计约 2,000 星标。
